generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The `toXContent` implementation in `getTruncatedInput()` calls `builder.value(TRUNCATED_RECORD_VALUE)`, which results in the "input" field being serialized as a plain string. However, the corresponding integration tests (e.g., in `#21BPQ`) and the logic for `getTruncatedWatchExecutionResult` suggest that this should be an object containing the `TRUNCATED_RECORD_KEY`. As currently written, any code attempting to cast the "input" field to a `Map` (as seen in the tests) will throw a `ClassCastException`.

review_comment: I'm also assuming that adding a new field to the history store doesn't need any further changes to mappings or anything?

It looks like `input` doesn't specify dynamic, so it defaults to dynamic (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/main/x-pack/plugin/core/template-resources/src/main/resources/watch-history.json#L108). And `result` is explicitly dynamic (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/main/x-pack/plugin/core/template-resources/src/main/resources/watch-history.json#L136).
